dependencies.name: request
dependencies.requiredAction: reuse without modifying shared HTTP infrastructure

dependencies.name: MenuApprovalPage
dependencies.requiredAction: create or locate the repository page boundary before wiring the operations

contractSecurity.implementationBoundary: 契约声明了 bearerAuth；本计划不新增 token 获取、Authorization header 构造或其他认证行为。需要在既有 API 边界确认如何满足该契约要求。

evidence: listMenus exposes optional query parameter page
listMenus exposes optional query parameter size
MenuPage requires page and size in the successful response

loading.when: 从发起查询到 HTTP 200 响应可供页面消费
loading.uiWork: 显示菜单列表加载状态

loading.when: 从发起提交到提交请求完成
loading.uiWork: 显示当前菜单的提交进行中状态，并防止同一动作的重复触发

empty.condition: listMenus 返回 HTTP 200，且 MenuPageResponse.data.items 为空数组
empty.uiWork: 显示列表空状态；空列表不是契约中定义的错误响应

error.condition: 查询请求失败或无法消费成功响应
error.contractEvidence: 契约只记录 listMenus 的 200 响应，没有记录错误响应 schema
error.uiWork: 显示查询错误状态，并保留重试入口；不要假设未记录的错误 body 字段
显示 ErrorResponse.code 和 ErrorResponse.message；其他未记录的失败形态交由既有错误边界处理

cases.name: success_with_items
cases.request: GET /api/v1/menus with optional page and size query parameters
cases.response: HTTP 200 application/json shaped as MenuPageResponse; use only declared fields and Menu.status enum values

cases.name: success_empty
cases.response: HTTP 200 application/json with MenuPageResponse.data.items as an empty array and the other required MenuPage fields

cases.name: request_failure
cases.response: rejected or otherwise failed request; do not invent an undocumented error response body

cases.name: success
cases.request: POST /api/v1/menus/{menuId}/submit with required path menuId and no request body

cases.name: business_error
cases.request: POST /api/v1/menus/{menuId}/submit with required path menuId and no request body
cases.response: HTTP 400 application/json shaped as ErrorResponse with code and message
